title: 2019-20 Panini Hoops Premium Michael Porter Jr #51 Nuggets
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops Premium Stock trading card features Michael Porter Jr. of the Denver Nuggets. The card is a #51 in the set and is a great addition to any NBA fan's collection. The card is from the National Basketball Association (NBA) and is a sports trading card.

This card is a Premium parallel/variety and features premium qualities. The card is not autographed and is unsigned. The manufacturer of the card is Panini. The card is from the 2019 season and is a great way to remember Michael Porter Jr.'s time with the Denver Nuggets.
